digest.component_or_area: test suite — pagination guard, transport repr, rate-limit retry, backend registry, assignee resolution
propositions: Five identified tests contain assertions that cannot fail due to tautologies, missing mock carriers, AST predicate re-implementation instead of shared-helper calls, or vacuous checks of membership rather than return-value contracts

test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport passes vacuously because the JiraDataCenterTransport constructor never receives a PAT credential and the class defines no __repr__, so the assertion over repr(t) cannot exercise the intended disclosure path

test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the AST walk inline instead of calling the shared _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() helper that the real guard uses, and can only fail if the ast module itself breaks

_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() is hardcoded to parse the live transport file and takes no parameters, blocking the teeth test from feeding it a synthetic unpaginated source unless the helper is first parameterized with an optional src argument

test_validate_assignee_exists_returns_the_dc_username asserts only hasattr(cls, 'validate_assignee_exists'), duplicating a parametrized presence test and never asserting that validate_assignee_exists returns a username string rather than a bool or accountId-shaped value

Four tests must be rewritten to assert the contracts their docstrings promise; test_an_unknown_backend_raises_the_registry_error_not_key_error must either call select_backend or be renamed to reflect that it pins only a class relationship, not raising behaviour
